mapper.select: INSERT INTO content (work_id, route, kind, license, retained, raw_sha256, doc_sha256, source_url) VALUES (#{o.workId}, #{o.route}, #{o.kind}, #{o.license}, #{o.retained}, #{o.rawSha256}, #{o.docSha256}, #{o.sourceUrl}) ON CONFLICT (work_id, route) DO UPDATE SET kind = EXCLUDED.kind, license = EXCLUDED.license, retained = EXCLUDED.retained, raw_sha256 = EXCLUDED.raw_sha256, doc_sha256 = EXCLUDED.doc_sha256, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, fetched_at = now() RETURNING id
SELECT * FROM content WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY id
